name: 纸媒宣言 · Paper Manifesto
tagline: Raw brutalist paper aesthetic — rust terracotta on warm cream, Georgia serif, zero-radius corners with solid block shadows.

palette.description: rust terracotta on warm cream paper — like a hand-cranked letterpress print

typography.style: serif headline + clean sans body, zero-radius brutalist

best_for: Anything that should feel raw, printed, and intentionally unpolished — artist manifestos, brand declarations, creative portfolios, anti-corporate pitch decks.
avoid_for: Formal corporate contexts where the rough edges and solid shadows read as unprofessional rather than intentional.
